name: split_flap_departure_board
promptTemplate: A station split-flap departure board in {{palette}} palette with {{cascade_speed}} cascade speed and {{flap_glow}} glow, cycling via {{message_cycle}} with mechanical {{jitter}} vibration and {{wear_vignette}} ambient depth.

palette.hint: Cycle board phosphor and flap colors

cascade_speed.hint: Riffle speed across the letter grid

message_cycle.hint: Switch destinations on bars or audio beat

listing.blurb: A mechanical split-flap departures board clatters through destinations and tempos, casting hinge shadows and phosphor glow across the wall.
listing.prompt: A station's split-flap departure board: rows of flaps riffling through the alphabet, each character stopping in turn, spelling destinations that are moods and times that are tempos, the whole board cascading to a new message every few bars, with a soft hinge shadow on every flap. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
